_about: Captions for the demo video (pnpm demo). One short line per shot, at most 12 words. After editing, run: pnpm demo --render-only. The user testing numbers are in docs/USER_TESTING.md.

title.heading: Many couples learn they share a carrier result, and are left with numbers, not a plan.
title.body: Results are hard to understand, genetic counsellors are few, and genetic data is deeply private.

s1.caption: Mariam opens her signed result, reads it, and explains it back.
s1.evidence: Understanding rose from 8 of 12 to 12 of 12 after Teach Back

s2.caption: Blind Couple Match: a shared carrier result, a plan, not a verdict.

s3.caption: Dr. Layla reads their questions, drafts with the Copilot, and signs.

intro.heading: Science changes. Mariam's result keeps up.

s4.caption: Her counsellor hears first, talks to her, then releases the update.

m1.caption: The Genetic Copilot answers in Arabic, with numbers from tested code.

m2.caption: Family Risk Engine: relatives by relationship, never by name.

m3.caption: Risk Beyond the Panel, seen by the counsellor first.

m4.caption: Population Signals: planning from privacy protected statistics.

closing.heading: Merros. Healthy families, planned together.
closing.note: An independent prototype, not affiliated with or endorsed by the Department of Health Abu Dhabi. All data is synthetic.
